talk_track: Daniel Kirichanski here — at Ripple I owned the program that cut cloud spend 35%, about $8M a year, while the platform cleared 6 billion annual transactions. Qdrant's Senior FinOps & Cloud Analyst posting says something most companies never admit out loud: 'This is not just a cost optimization role. It is a unit economics role.' Two cost-analyst roles posted the same day, alongside a VP of Engineering search open since April, reads as cloud gross margin becoming a board-level number right after the $50M Series B. The pattern I have seen twice at payments scale: an analyst can surface the unit economics, but the savings live in architecture and provisioning decisions only engineering leadership can move. Until the VP seat is filled, that gap is where the margin leaks. Who owns cloud gross margin while the VP Engineering search runs?
